summary: This bill designates the United States Postal Service facility located at 130 South Patterson Avenue in Santa Barbara, California, as the "Brigadier General Frederick R. Lopez Post Office Building".

scores.thoughts: This bill is solely about renaming a post office. While there might be a negligible administrative cost associated with updating signs or records, it does not involve any significant appropriation or reduction of government funds, nor does it alter any spending policies. Therefore, its impact on government spending is effectively zero.
